title: Minimax sublevel set is contained in the row set
statement: Let $X \subseteq \bbr$ be a set, let $f \colon \bbr \times \bbr \to \bbr$ be a payoff function, and let $y, c \in \bbr$. Then the minimax sublevel set $\mathrm{sublevel}(X,f,y,c) = X \cap \{x \in \bbr : f(x,y) \leq c\}$ is contained in $X$.
hypotheses_covered: X a subset of the reals
f a real payoff function of two arguments
